user.title: DomoTwin
user.description: Add DomoTwin, your home as a live 3D twin. You will import your plan from the DomoTwin panel in the sidebar.

data_description.sidebar: The full-screen view with the editor. Dashboard cards work either way.
data_description.sidebar_admin_only: Other users can still use DomoTwin cards on dashboards.

show.name: Show
show.description: Shows a room, an element, a storey or a view on the DomoTwin screens (cards and panel), or on one of them.

room.name: Room
room.description: A room of the plan, by its name or its id (on any storey).

element.name: Element
element.description: Any element of the plan, by its name or its id: it is framed.

storey.name: Storey
storey.description: A storey, by its name, its id or its number (0 for the ground floor, 1 above, -1 below); all for every storey at once.

view.name: View
view.description: overview, 3d, 2d, walk (at eye level, to the room given), or the name of a saved viewpoint.

person.name: Person
person.description: A person DomoTwin places (person.…): their room is shown, if they are at home in a room known.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: The screen to show it on: a card's screen option. Empty for every screen.

where.name: Where
where.description: Where a person is, or a device DomoTwin follows by Bluetooth, or everyone at home: their room, and a sentence to answer with (in Home Assistant's language).

name.name: Name
name.description: A person's name, or a followed device's ("my keys"), as said (a first name is enough, a letter off is forgiven). Empty for everyone at home.

show.name: Show
show.description: Also show their room on the DomoTwin screens.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: The screen to show it on: a card's screen option. Empty for every screen.
